== Evaluation ==
* Brandon: I find in myself an excitement and, something that I have felt before, urgency that comes from holding onto Shawn's new energy too tightly.  I think that is incorrect, that what we have is either durable or not and that grabbing it urgently won't change that, and so I want to hold onto Shawn's energy with a more open hand.
* Eric: I am here, and here is where I’m going to be.. I have no fear that this will cease to be a part of my life, or that I will cease to be a part of it… I know at a very deep level that this, whatever we’re going to call it (solseed/gaia’s people/foundation) will evolve and I am eager to be part of that evolution and I’m eager for Buckleberry to be part of that evolution.
* Shawn: I hear what Brandon is saying and I feel that energy and am excited and I have a fear for myself that I might lose interest if we don’t do something concrete.  I also feel like that is inaccurate … you have been doing this for so long.  I’m just projecting my own experience of waxing/waning over time.  These different ideas are just manifestations of this baseline core understanding of what we are doing here.  And that I feel is in alignment.  But I do want to get stuff done because it is exciting and fun.
